Q5217.reason: The confirmation was expressly conditional on assent to the loading charge, so under UCC 2-207 it operated as a counteroffer and no contract formed without acceptance.

Q6156.reason: The engineer is unavailable and the company had motive and opportunity to cross-examine him in the prior deposition, so the testimony qualifies as former testimony.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani the ECtHR held that state immunity prevailed over the Article 6 right of access to a court.
